rationale: No. Read in full: EO 10733 only amends section 3 of EO 10479 (Government Contract Committee membership). Section 403 of EO 10925 (held Federal Register text, 26 FR 1977) names EO 10733 "(22 F.R. 8135)", declares it and EO 10479 "hereby revoked" and abolishes the Committee; under its section 402 the order took effect thirty days after execution on 1961-03-06, i.e. 1961-04-05. Both observations (the 22 FR 8135 catalog record and the 1989 OFR 'Revoked by EO 10925' row) agree and were reviewed; no earlier end, partial-scope limit or surviving independent command was found. Records and property transferred to the President's Committee on Equal Employment Opportunity (savings).
